subject: Re: DPA execution — QA pass, SCCs addendum, DocuSign staging
messages:
From: Anna Novak <anna.novak@brightline.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightline Legal <legal@brightline.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: DPA final redlines + SCCs addendum — request to confirm execution path

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We ran the updated DPA and the SCCs addendum by our counsel overnight. They attached a very short list of items they want clarified before signing (see attached). The three asks from legal are:

- Confirm whether Redwood will accept the UK IDTA addendum in-lieu of a separate UK addendum (they prefer a single appendix approach).
- Confirm retention of flow-down obligations for subprocessors and where we can find the subprocessor list for the Dedicated product.
- Provide a copy of the evidence log for recent transfers to the EU for the last 30 days (audit stub will do).

We plan to sign via DocuSign once those points are resolved; can you confirm target timeline? Brightline is hoping to close this week to keep their rollout timing.

Attachments: [Brightline_latest_comments.pdf (PDF, 28 KB)]

Best,
Anna Novak
Head of Legal Operations
Brightline
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Anna Novak <anna.novak@brightline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA final redlines + SCCs addendum — request to confirm execution path

Anna — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. Quick responses inline below so your counsel has something to review immediately.

1) UK IDTA: Redwood can accept the UK IDTA language as an addendum to the SCCs addendum (single appendix). We have 2 small drafting preferences to keep contractual symmetry (minor cross-reference tweaks); I attached a 2-line suggestion in the draft.

2) Subprocessors: We will flow down core security and confidentiality obligations to subprocessors. The Dedicated product runs on a managed pool; the active subprocessor list is published and we will share the current snapshot. For onboarding transparency, we propose a clause that requires Redwood to notify Brightline 30 days before adding any subprocessor with access to customer data.

3) Transfer evidence: We can provide a transfer evidence export (audit stub) that shows dataset hash + transfer path and the SCCs reference for the last 30 days. I will ask Ops for the export and transmit it under secure link.

DocuSign approach: propose this execution path — (a) sign the DPA + SCCs addendum in DocuSign PowerForm; (b) Redwood sends a parallel confirmation email with the subprocessor snapshot and evidence link; (c) both countersigned copies stored in our contract repository and a HubSpot deal update. If that works for you we can prepare the envelope tonight for morning execution.

I've attached our redline (Brightline_DPA_rk_redlines_v2.pdf) and the SCCs addendum draft with 2-line change (SCCs_addendum_draft_20261108.docx). Marissa / Karthik: please confirm the 30-day notification window and whether Ops can provide the evidence export before EOD PST.

Attachments: [Brightline_DPA_rk_redlines_v2.pdf (PDF, 72 KB), SCCs_addendum_draft_20261108.docx (Word, 45 KB)]

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts
Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.com)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Anna Novak <anna.novak@brightline.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPA final redlines + SCCs addendum — request to confirm execution path

Anna / team — quick ops update.

- Evidence export: Ops produced the 30-day transfer stub and uploaded it to a secure bucket. Link (preview-only) below. We redacted internal job ids per privacy guidance.
- Subprocessor snapshot: Current list for Dedicated is attached; we will also include a commitment to 30-day notice for any new processors with data access.
- DocuSign staging: I'll create the PowerForm envelope and pre-populate the DPA + SCCs addendum. DocuSign will send a notifications copy to Brightline + Redwood legal when signed. Once Anna confirms the single-appendix approach we will stage the envelope tonight and send first-try to your signing group tomorrow morning.

Evidence link (preview): https://files.redwood.com/s/secure/preview/transfer-stub-BGL-4821
Attachments: [Dedicated_subprocessors_snapshot_20261109.csv (CSV, 16 KB)]

Anna, if Brightline legal approves the two-line symmetry tweak on the UK IDTA cross-reference, we are ready to execute on DocuSign.

— Marissa
Director, Contracts Operations
Redwood Inference
